# Contributing

This repository publishes a verified knowledge graph. The graph grows only
through its verification pipeline (a proposing model, a gating model from a
different family, a cross-vendor audit, a human decision), so data changes
do not arrive by pull request. What the project wants from readers is
challenges and confirmations.

## Dispute a claim

Expand the citation in the atlas, press dispute to copy a prefilled
report, and file it with the "Dispute an edge" issue form. The one
requirement, the same one the site states: say what the cited paragraph
says. A dispute that engages
the paragraph gets an answer on the record; the outcome lands in the public
dispute log at https://symbolicworld.observer/disputes. Reports that do not
engage the paragraph are closed as incomplete.

## Confirm a claim

Check the cited paragraph in any edition, press confirm on the citation in
the atlas, and file the prefilled report with the "Confirm an edge" issue
form. Confirmations enter the edge's public verification record.

## Code

Tooling fixes (the query CLI, the exporters, the tests) are welcome as
issues first. The pipeline and the graph data are maintained privately and
mirrored here at releases.
